description_en: Deletes a notification policy in a specified workspace. After deletion, the policy no longer sends notifications for subscribed events
description_zh: 删除指定工作空间下的通知策略。删除后该策略不再对订阅事件发送通知
name: DeleteNotifyPolicy

parameters.help_en: The workspace ID. Used to isolate notification policy resources across different business spaces
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间 ID，用于隔离不同业务空间的通知策略资源
parameters.name: workspace

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the notification policy, returned by the creation operation
parameters.help_zh: 通知策略的唯一标识，由创建接口返回
parameters.name: uuid
